track: Demo D13 Pooled-Agent Loops Under Encoder Change & Withdrawal
primary_endpoint: Single primary paired 2x2 interaction contrast on on-time cited correct jobs/minute at pool size 4, retaining every eligible job including late or timed-out jobs in denominator

evidence_disclosure.scope: Stage-1 controlled replay passes offline (deterministic, 4 schedules x 24 templates at pool size 4).
evidence_disclosure.live_worker_outcome: FAILED. The committed run-live-workers receipt (nemotron-lightning, 7842 live calls, 70 cells, 1680 jobs) has overall_pass=false and status=replay-fail: gates beats_full_restart_rebuild_jpm and sham_reopen_control_valid are false.
evidence_disclosure.sla: All 1680 eligible jobs missed the 560 ms SLA (live worker latency ~3.7-7.9 s): on_time_cited_correct_jobs=0, so the full-restart comparator ties at 0.0 JPM and the primary interaction LCB is 0.
evidence_disclosure.label_deviation: Orchestrator label map: stage1-replay-and-live-worker-pass. The live worker did NOT pass, so only stage1-replay-pass is claimed.
evidence_disclosure.synthetic: Matter templates and arrival schedules are synthetic.
evidence_disclosure.tuning: The 560 ms deadline and stall constants are preregistered; they were not retuned to rescue the live run.
